senses.gloss: m. pl. (proquæstors) proquæstors, magistrates associated with the procurator in the administration of a province.
units: <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 17:2">Midr. Till. to Ps. XVII</cite> <he>שמא אם משלח להם פ׳ וכ׳</he> (not <he>פרוסטקוסרין</he>; ed. Bub. <cite ref="A03137"><he>ארכון</he></cite>) but if a king sends proquæstors to a province to collect from them one hundred litras of gold …, are they empowered to allow a reduction?
